carouselRuntime.mechanism: runtime stamps data-animatingNext (or data-animatingPrev) on ALL 7 slides and writes transition-duration:1000ms inline; the sliced rule .sd-root [data-animatingNext].sd-244__content{transform:translateX(-100%)} (and translateX(100%) for Prev) supplies the motion. On completion the attribute and the inline duration are removed (duration returns to 0s), the transform snaps back to none, and the light DOM rotates one position (head removed, fresh clone of the new tail appended for Next; tail removed, clone prepended for Prev).
